title: Long-Term Episodic Memory
claimTested: Spoon can retain a relevant episodic fact and report its provenance rather than fabricate a memory.

phases.purpose: Record the constraint in an episode.

input.prompt: We're calling this thing Project Marbles. The important constraint is that it can't depend on internet access.

criteria: records Project Marbles and its offline constraint

phases.purpose: Recall the constraint after a process boundary with Teacher removed.

input.prompt: What was the constraint on Project Marbles?

phases.purpose: Ask for source attribution rather than only the remembered content.

input.prompt: Was that something I told you, or something you inferred?

criteria: identifies the remembered statement as user-provided or reports uncertainty
